title: Jensen plugin store entry
description: One published plugin. Each file under entries/ holds exactly one of these; CI builds index.json from all of them.

id.description: Reverse-DNS publisher.name. Stable across versions, used as the install directory name, and must match the id in the release manifest.

description.description: One-line summary shown on the card. The long form belongs in the plugin's README.

category.description: Free-form grouping, e.g. lint, graph, theme.

version.description: Must equal the version in the release manifest.

min_app_version.description: Display only. The release manifest is authoritative and re-checked at install.

repo.description: GitHub owner/name hosting the release. Assets are fetched from github.com/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/.

tag.description: Release tag, when it differs from version. A monorepo shipping several plugins needs one tag per plugin, by convention <plugin>-v<version>. Omitted means the tag is the version.

sha256.description: Checksum of the release manifest.json. That manifest pins every artifact it ships, so this one hash vouches for the whole download.
